FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_MotorControl
VAR_INPUT
    Pressure_LOW : REAL; // Input pressure value
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    Motor_Critical : BOOL; // Output motor state
END_VAR

VAR
    Threshold : REAL := 36464; // Pressure threshold value
END_VAR

// Main logic to evaluate motor state
IF Pressure_LOW < Threshold THEN
    Motor_Critical := TRUE; // Trigger motor if pressure is below threshold
ELSE
    Motor_Critical := FALSE; // Do not trigger motor if pressure is above or equal to threshold
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
